data.body:
[P2] Distinguish interrupted response bodies from invalid JSON

`response.json()` reads the response body as well as parsing it. If the connection fails after successful HTTP headers arrive, this catch converts the transport failure into `DeciderInvalidResponseError`. With the deadline still unexpired, the default strategy treats that error as permanent and fails the operation without retrying. Separate body-read failures from JSON parse failures: preserve retryable transport errors and reserve `DeciderInvalidResponseError` for malformed content. Add coverage for an interrupted successful response.
